kyack: n. (美國西部掛在馱鞍兩側的)馱袋
kyat: n the basic unit of money in Myanmar
kylie: n. an Australian boomerang; one side flat and the other convex
kymograph:
n. 波動曲線記錄儀
[醫] 記波[紋]器
n. scientific instrument consisting of a rotating drum holding paper on which a stylus traces a continuous record (as of breathing or blood pressure)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 cym-＋-graph</dd></dl>
kyphosis:
n. 駝背
[醫] 脊柱後凸, 駝背
n. an abnormal backward curve to the vertebral column
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">較早形式 cyphosis 的變體（可能仿德語 Kyphosis），借自中世紀拉丁語，借自希臘語 kýphōsis，源自 kȳphós（“向前彎的、駝背的、佝僂的”，來源不確定）＋-ōsis（-osis）</dd></dl>
